_help: Everything on the explore page comes from this file.
Search matches every item's title across all categories (fuzzy: letters in order, close together).
Every link opens in a new tab.

promoted: a few hand-picked direct links, {title, items:[{label, link}]}. They scroll in the Promoted box at the bottom of the page, and the very same links are the 'Try' list shown when search is opened (they disappear once a letter is typed). Leave items empty to hide both. hints-title is the small heading above the 'Try' list.

categories: shown as boxes in this order. Each has id, title, description (the sub line) and groups. A group is a sub-category: {title, description?, items:[{title, link}]}. Add as many groups as you like in any category (e.g. 'Claude certifications', 'AWS certifications', 'ML generals'); both the List and Tiles views keep the groups apart under their own headings. A category may instead have a flat 'items' list (no sub-categories).
